data.title: Hop Back on the Number Line
data.description: Learn how to use the number line to subtract by jumping backwards.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the number 2. Now hop back 2 spaces to the left to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Count your hops carefully as you jump backwards one by one.

challenges.instruction: Find your starting spot at 9 on the number line. Now, hop backward 4 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Put your finger on 9 and count backward 4 hops one by one to find your new spot.

challenges.instruction: Find the number 13 on the number line. Make a big jump forward by 2 to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Start at 13 and count forward 2 hops on the number line: one, two!

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 11 and hop backwards 2 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Try counting backwards one hop at a time: start at 11, then hop left twice.
